beats.play_hint_guide: guide: every step is confirmed by you
beats.play_hint_goal: goal: the main agent reads full receipts and dispatches by itself (gates are never skipped)
beats.play_done_goal: [RUN · AUTONOMOUS] every requirement is closed; this run was dispatched by the main agent itself, settlement is produced by --settle.
beats.rejected: [REJECTED:ACTION] `{{action}}` is not available in stage {{stage}}. Allowed actions: {{allowed}}. Reason: {{detail}}
beats.rejected_payload: [REJECTED:PAYLOAD] the payload for `{{action}}` cannot be accepted: {{detail}} Primary state unchanged.
beats.stage_expected: 该动作只在微状态「{{expected}}」可用
beats.bad_index: [CHOICE OUT OF RANGE] {{stage}} has {{count}} options, got {{index}}.
beats.bad_score: Score must be an integer 1-5, got `{{got}}`.
beats.default_lesson: split small first, parallelize next, accept on evidence
beats.charter_ok: [CHARTER SET] 章程已立（立局内可反复修订）：「{{title}}」｜目标：{{goal}}｜成功判据：{{success}}
beats.gate_charter_first: charter the run first: boot with an event.start payload ("title|description") and add at least one requirement before closing
beats.coordinate_ok: [COORDINATION DONE] {{count}} 条需求全部终态——批边界，进入盘点幕（run.batch={{batch}}）
beats.verify_ok: [GATES GREEN] {{count}} requirements closed; final review is now allowed.
beats.verify_fail: [GATES FAILED] #{{failures}}: sent back to coordinate for rework.
beats.gate_bypass: [GATES BYPASSED] failure #{{failures}}, but require_all_green is off → final review allowed.
beats.secret_redline: Red line: credentials live only in .env / .env.local; Mod resources, config and reports expose key names only.
beats.evolution_off: evolution off: only the review is recorded; no evolution suggestions.
beats.evolution_suggest: evolution suggest: produce suggestions (see the evolution chapter); annotated paths {{paths}} — never auto-rewritten.
beats.default_req_payload: add a requirement|write the title and description here, pipe-separated (third segment = external idempotency id, fourth segment = deps r1,r2)
beats.handover_goal: [DECISION HANDOVER] play.mode = goal: the main agent reads the full receipt and then dispatches by itself (never the default first option, never a script); acceptance and both gates still take one real action and one validation each, evidence standards unchanged. The closing review must account for the delegated scope.
beats.handover_guide: [DECISION HANDOVER] play.mode = guide: every following step is confirmed by a human (reply with the index); milestone actions still need the menu ticket.
beats.prologue_common: shared by both modes: acceptance and both gates still take one real action and one validation each, never skipped; requirements can be added asynchronously (--requirement / --proposal).
beats.coordinate_common: accept proposals first (proposal.accept), then pass gates (gate.approve/reject), then dispatch (requirement.dispatch), finally coordinate.submit.
beats.stage_prompt_missing: (the prompt for this node is missing: check <node>_common in data/scenes.json)
beats.evolution_auto: evolution auto: preference marker only (cap {{cap}}, paths {{paths}}) — no auto-rewrite, no revision requests registered; suggestions still go through the separate settlement.evolution registration.
beats.run_retire_armed: [RUN RETIRE ARMED] the next review.note becomes the retiring close: the run settles and ends ([ENDING · run retired]). Clear it with `config.set run.retire=""`.
beats.run_retire_cleared: [RUN RETIRE CLEARED] review.note is back to the batch settle (resident run continues; no ending).
beats.profile_bad_assignments: assignments must be a comma-separated list of `r<n>[:<stage>]` tokens (<= 16 tokens, <= 512 chars total), e.g. `r1:plan,r1:development,r3`.
beats.profile_bad_handle: a profile key must be `profile.<handle>.<key>` with a handle-shaped handle (non-empty after trim, <= 64 chars, no whitespace, no `|`).
beats.profile_bad_value: invalid profile value for this key (harness <= 32, session_id <= 128: no whitespace / no `|` / no quotes; role <= 64 single line; free keys `^[a-z0-9_]{1,32}$` with single-line values <= 256).
beats.profile_registered: [PROFILE REGISTERED] {{handle}}.{{field}} (self-reported, not identity proof; the executor ledger stays the authority for accountability).
beats.charter_payload: 任务标题|要达成的一句话目标|可判定的成功标准
beats.charter_usage: 章程三段："标题|目标|成功判据"——三段都必须非空
beats.charter_missing: 章程三件套未齐备（task.title / task.goal / task.success 任一为空）：先 charter.set 补齐再 run.begin
beats.charter_locked: 章程在 run.begin 后锁定：当前微状态「{{phase}}」不可再改章程
beats.charter_begun: 局已开工：run.begin 只在立局微状态可用（当前「{{phase}}」）
beats.run_begun: [RUN BEGUN] 章程锁定，任务「{{title}}」开工（{{count}} 条需求在册）→ 协调幕
beats.phase_expected: 该动作需要微状态「{{expected}}」（当前「{{current}}」）
beats.settle_ready: [SETTLE READY] 盘点四项齐备（验证/演进登记/会话清理/待办清理）——自动进入发布幕
beats.charter_common: 立局幕：章程三件套（标题/目标/成功判据）立好才可开工；charter.set 在立局内可反复修订，run.begin 后章程锁定。
beats.settle_common: 盘点幕四项：verify.submit 先全绿 → settlement.evolution 登记演进（可并入会话/待办可选段）→ settlement.sessions → settlement.todo；四项齐备自动转发布幕（不占事件）。
beats.release_common: 发布幕：release.confirm 声明 master@<sha> 与批次 tag（v年.月.日.序号），或 release.skip 声明跳过理由；任一成立即「发布已声明」，review.note 才可批结算/退役。
beats.retired_common: 退役终态：业务事件全拒；map.show / requirement.list 只读查询仍可用。
